title.zh: 不含连续 1 的非负整数

desc.zh: 从二进制小例子推导后缀计数，按首次不同的位划分答案。
desc.en: Count binary suffixes and partition answers by their first differing bit.

complexity: O(log n) time; O(log n) auxiliary space (unit-cost arithmetic within the official bounds)

concepts.name: Binary suffix counting
concepts.description: Split valid padded bit strings into leading 0 and leading 10 cases.

concepts.name: First-different-bit partition
concepts.description: Count disjoint smaller-prefix branches and stop the equal path at adjacent ones.
